summary: Phase L.25 / Phase 1C-VAV verification. Tested VAV modal extraction into /js/dashboard/vav-modal.js. All 7 review-request criteria passed: VAV modal renders via URL param with full chrome (title, type, QR + POP OUT testids), QR overlay opens/displays SVG/has correct deep-link URL/closes on Escape, POP OUT spawns a new page, vav-modal.js module fetched 200 with correct content-type and the expected header start, pill transform scales are clamped in [0.8, 1.2], AHU modal regression intact (z-[130] modal with 'AHU-01-E EQUIPMENT DIAGRAM'), and the dashboard boots clean (no Babel red overlay, no pageerrors, sidebar icons render).

ctx prop interface with 24+ keys is brittle; future refactor to a true React functional component (<VavEquipmentModal {...ctx} />) as the JSDoc notes would let React tooling validate the boundary.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1C-VAV extraction is verified green. Phase 1D will repeat the same pattern on the AHU equipment modal (~610-line IIFE). When that lands, re-run criteria #6 (AHU modal opens via ?modal_ahu= URL param) plus the same QR/POP OUT/pill-scale checks against the AHU modal at z-[130].
